messages: #p207#, who lives in the little mushroom house in #m10001000#, seems to want to follow the clue written on #t4031122#.

From #b#t4031122##k, which I obtained after defeating #o700000#, the one who'd attacked #p207#, I picked up two leads: #b#m10002000##k and #p602#. I think it'd be best to head to #b#m10005000##k first and go hear what #b#p602##k has to say.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I met #p602# at #m10005000#. It seems I might be able to track down the warrior who saved #p207# more easily than I thought.
